title: Sam B NDE 20624
content:
Northwestern College, Evanston, IL Sponsored-Sailing Nationals, Top 10 schools in town for the event. Water temp. was 41 degrees, snow on the ground. The mood was intense and the elements were tough. Our boat capsized: 'A Flying Junior' small craft, sloop rigging, two man operation. As the captain, I attempted to recover the boat from flipping and in doing so, I was tossed underneath the sail as the vessel capsized. (Personal floatation devices were present and being used by both of us.) Garments were not selected for submerging, only for the air elements. Time was of essence but not on my side. After 9 quick minutes of persistence, maneuvering became difficult. My limbs seized, my chest grew tight my efforts were useless. Time was now about 14 minutes: the water got warm...bright flowers glowed in front of my vision, soon after covered by a frost-like haze. I pushed out a softly spoken 'Help' only for myself to hear. At the next moment...'She has no pulse, she's a led weight, start counting!1!2!3!4....I watched and heard a woman in a orange jacket, letters on her back, US Coast Guard was talking to me, for a brief moment. Arriving at the boathouse I was jostled and at that moment I started hearing people talk again. 2 years later I took a class in college, Death & Dying, where I was asked if I had experienced any near death situations. My instructor informed me that I had an out of body experience, as if I was unconscious, I wouldn't have seen or heard anything, much less looking down on a woman's back to see lettering on her orange jacket.

elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone | Boundary
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Conservative/fundamentalist very little belief in religion, excepting of family's views
elements.What is your religion now?: Conservative/fundamentalist I have found my spiritual direction
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I've come to believe that everyone need a higher power to exist. Mine is internal. When I spoke of help, I was talking to my soul to give me the adrenalin to fight back
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: No Hypothermia, Cardiac exhaust, unconscious for about 49 seconds
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Realizing later what occurred and slipping back to that point in time and see it happening for the first time and making sense.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Shock but respect that my words were my truths.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Everything happens for a reason. I am still a great sailor!
